data.cultural_impact: The Hindu name "Ritam" carries a deep cultural significance in the Hindu tradition, rooted in its rich history and philosophy. The use of this name holds an implied connection to the deeper meaning of the cosmos, rhythm, and order in Hinduism. In various Hindu scriptures and practices, Ritam is seen as the embodiment of cosmic order, harmony, and truth. It is celebrated as the divine force that governs the universe and sets the rhythm for all existence.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spiritual belief, the name "Ritam" holds immense significance as it represents the ultimate truth and reality of the universe. It implies an inherent purity, honesty, and harmony in all aspects of life. This name is believed to evoke inner peace, wisdom, and enlightenment in those who bear it. It is a reminder of our deep connection to the Sacred Cosmic Order and our role in maintaining it, both within ourselves and in the world around us.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ritam is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a name of the god of time The name Ritam carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ritam is associated with the concept of time and its cyclical nature

trends: increasing popularity in Indian diaspora communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ritam remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Ritam from Chennai, India embodies the meaning of Ritam - "The Essence". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Ritam represents the cosmic rhythm and order in the universe, embodying harmony and truth. It is the inner voice guiding one towards righteous actions and moral integrity.
